headline: Danantara Reveals Cause of Delayed Release of Old Financial Statements
summary: BPI Danantara explained the lengthy process behind its financial report, which it attributed to consolidating about 1,000 companies. The delay in release was the subject of the update.
why: Timely financial reporting matters to investors and lenders assessing state-linked holding companies in Indonesia.
original_headline: Danantara Ungkap Penyebab Laporan Keuangan Lama Keluar
